title: One reviewed processor image, named by the commit it was built from, for the demo and every rehearsal; the doctor sees a stale one
kind: code and tests only; no Docker engine was used, no image was built and no runtime was touched

pin.why: the latest staging commit that changed services/geo; it holds c7a7e720 (resolve-geojson-crs), the REH2 blocker

decisions: Staleness is judged by the services/geo tree hash (the image's whole build context), not the commit, so a pin stays current across commits that change nothing under services/geo.
The image carries two labels: org.opencontainers.image.revision (commit) and in.bhuaayam.ulpin.services-geo-tree (tree). An image without them (demo-k3b, demo-s03) fails the doctor.
The demo no longer builds through compose: every runtime runs the pinned image and only processor-image.mjs build makes it, refusing a dirty services/geo and never building over a present tag.

demo.compose.json is removed; rehearsal.compose.yaml became processors.compose.yaml for all runtimes, with the image from ULPIN_PROCESSOR_IMAGE that demo.mjs sets from the pin. It keeps ULPIN_PROFILE=demo, which the demo's processors already have through K3b's overlay.

processor-image.mjs roll recreates only geo and worker (--no-deps --force-recreate --no-build) after bringing the stores up with --no-recreate; it refuses while the API or dispatcher runs, without the pinned image, or from a checkout whose services/geo is not the pin.
The start command is not given a new condition; the doctor reports the stale image as FAIL 'Processors run the pinned image, built from this checkout's services/geo'.

checks.newTests: scripts/platform/processor-image.test.mjs (8) and one more in runtime-image.test.mjs; all pass
checks.failuresNotFromThisChange: every failing test also fails on untouched staging in this Linux session: they need E:/ paths, Windows interpreters or a configured gateway; the runtime-stop process-identity tests fail 1 or 2 of 6 on both trees from run to run
